page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-2xL4 is an x86_64 architecture server virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. The system features 16 vCPUs with a shared CPU allocation model and is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace family, delivering a combined total of 48 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The shared CPU allocation presents a performance tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, non-burstable CPU execution. However, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dual-GPU configuration make this server profile suitable for GPU-accelerated workloads, machine learning inference, and data science tasks that rely heavily on graphics processing units rather than dedicated physical CPU cores.
